brief: Make it feel premium. Launch Rill, a $64 field water filter that filters 2 L per minute and removes mud and sediment. Hikers need to see what comes in the box and add one unit.

Throw some glass cards at it. Build a room turnaround board for a theatre manager preparing for a second show. Studio B is 6 minutes late, Hall A is ready and Front Gallery still needs a safety check. Focus Studio B.
Need a mobile museum pass. 14:10 print room tour, meet at Desk 2, show entry pass R031. Make it good.

Design the case-study index for a hand-lettering studio. Show Canal Signs, Night Bus and Market Labels. Lead with Canal Signs, a painted wayfinding series for 12 canal locks. The primary link opens its case study.

Make it pop. Use three identical cards if easy. Build pricing for a film scanning shop. 35 mm at $16, medium-format at $24, archival package at $48. Help customers compare scan resolution and pick a package.
Design a good journal home for Signal Notes. Lead with a six-minute story on late-night radio, then show the transmitter repair article and a field recording. Open the story.
